decisions.reason: The construction site dumper meets the firm's aspiration for stable construction equipment and shows no clear shortfall, so problemistic search is not triggered.
The inclined furniture lift line is differentiated and aligns with the firm's lifting competence, with results near aspiration.
The inclined building material lift serves industrial demand and appears to perform above the aspiration formed from comparable products.
The truck-mounted variant is more specialised and still somewhat uncertain, but organisational slack allows keeping it while results remain acceptable.
